# x402-geohash-toolkit

Deterministic geohash encode / decode / neighbors microservice.
Agent-native, no-human-in-loop, exact USDC micropayments via x402 on Base.

## Endpoints
- GET /catalog — free discovery
- POST /api/geohash — paid

## Pricing
~0.004–0.009 USDC per call (exact scheme)

## Usage
Send POST with JSON { "action": "encode"|"decode"|"neighbors", "lat"?: number, "lon"?: number, "precision"?: number, "hash"?: string }
Receive 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED, pay, retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.
